name: Un'Goro Soil
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The soil of Un'Goro Crater is reportedly enriched with potent magical qualities.  I want to know facts from falsehoods; go into the wilds of Un'Goro and acquire enough quality samples of soil for our continued study.

You may think that collection tasks are beneath you; that sort of attitude does not endear yourself to me or the Cenarion Circle.  Bring the samples to Jenal, who is no doubt wasting time outside behind this tree; just look for the piles of dirt.  He will handle the logistics - not I.
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Jenal at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Unload your precious cargo here, noble Champion. It must have been quite the burden... not unlike the burden I carry being a visionary. Here is an honorarium for your work, as dictated by the Arch Druid himself.

Arch Druid Staghelm wants to speak with you again adventurer, but for his next task you will be aided if you have a journeyman's understanding of Herbalism. If you don't know it though, you will still be able to aid the Circle!
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah yes, the dirt. The Arch Druid wants twenty loads per adventurer, and twenty loads he shall get. Let those who conspire against us fall to the wayside!
